title: PUBLIC/PRIVATE/INTERFACE 传播语义求解器：算出每个目标可见的 include 集合（正反两组）
expected_output:
[图 A：math 以 PUBLIC 链接 core（传播成立）]
  app   自用 include=['app/src']
  app   对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=[]
  app   对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=[]
  app   编译期可见 include=['app/src']
  core  自用 include=['core/include']
  core  对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=[]
  core  对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=[]
  core  编译期可见 include=['core/include']
  math  自用 include=['math/include']
  math  对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=['core/include']
  math  对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=['core']
  math  编译期可见 include=['core/include', 'math/include']
  判定 app 可直接使用 core 的头文件 = False
[图 B：math 以 PRIVATE 链接 core（不传播）]
  app   自用 include=['app/src']
  app   对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=[]
  app   对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=[]
  app   编译期可见 include=['app/src']
  core  自用 include=['core/include']
  core  对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=[]
  core  对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=[]
  core  编译期可见 include=['core/include']
  math  自用 include=['math/include']
  math  对外 INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES=[]
  math  对外 INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES=[]
  math  编译期可见 include=['math/include']
  判定 app 可直接使用 core 的头文件 = False
[结论] 图 B 中 app 若直接 include core 的头文件会编译失败：
       PRIVATE 依赖只对 math 自己可见，不会被 app 继承（这正是漏写 PUBLIC 的典型后果）
[判定] 4 个传播判定全部符合预期 = False
